reply.emotion: a practical, everyday moment as you set the table for a meal
notes: In French, 'serviette' covers both items you use at the table and those you use in the bathroom. To be more specific, you can say 'serviette de table' (napkin) or 'serviette de bain' (bath towel).

senses.definition: A piece of cloth or paper used to protect clothes while eating or to wipe your mouth.

examples.text: N'oublie pas de mettre une serviette sur la table.
examples.translation: Don't forget to put a napkin on the table.
examples.emotion: helpful and organized, reminding someone about the table setting

senses.definition: A piece of absorbent cloth used for drying your body or hair after washing.

examples.text: Elle prend une serviette propre pour se sécher les mains.
examples.translation: She takes a clean towel to dry her hands.
examples.emotion: matter-of-fact and calm, describing a simple daily routine
